name: Bread, Hertzberg
body:
Station and Complexity patissier 1

Flavor Profiles salty
Additional Ingredients none

EFFECT

Duration permanent; Serving Size 1d4

DESCRIPTION

A Hertzberg is a bread made without kneading, comprised of flour, salt, water, and yeast. Each serving counts as 1 day of rations.
